discoverer: P. L. Clark, P. Corn, A. Rice, J. Stankewicz
reference: P. L. Clark, P. Corn, A. Rice, J. Stankewicz, Computation on elliptic curves with complex multiplication, LMS J. Comput. Math. 17 (2014), 509-535, Section 4.8; explicit points: F. Najman, Torsion of elliptic curves over number fields of degree 6, 7, 8 and 9 (2026), https://hexagonmath.org/2611.00073v2, Proposition 13.4.
notes: The CM curve y^2 + (1-i)xy - iy = x^3 - ix^2 (j = 1728) over K = Q(zeta_20) = Q(a), i = a^5, with P of order 5 and Q of order 10; the Weil pairing e_5(P,2Q) = -a^6 is a primitive fifth root of unity. E(K)_tors = Z/5 x Z/10: the reductions at the primes (41, a-2) and (61, a-8) are good with 50 points each. Relative degree 2 over Q(zeta_5). Z/5 x Z/10 is a sporadic torsion group in degree 8; it is not known whether this is the only octic curve with this torsion group.
